review_summary: H01-013 DONE/PASS. H03 supervision remains logically intact but is now bound to the single global Windows Mission Control at 127.0.0.1:8891. Global MC v0.8.45 exposes the H03 bridge and runtime endpoints and owns the three H03 browser-resource scheduled tasks. The redundant standalone h03-bridge-only process at 127.0.0.1:8892 was stopped after equivalence verification; post-change audit confirms 8892 closed and only the global MC process/listener remains. Host-local H03 handoff state was updated to declare GLOBAL_CONTROL_PLANE ownership, endpoint 8891, standalone_h03_mission_control=false and legacy 8892 retired. Founder-login state stays WAITING_FOUNDER_LOGIN and no H03 browser credential/session state was altered.
